name: Speedlight (flashgun)
definition: small battery flash that mounts on the camera hot shoe or a stand.
notes: B&H on-camera flashes (328) include Godox V1, Nikon SB-700 Speedlight, Ricoh GF-2; hot-shoe TTL flashes.

name: Studio monolight (strobe head)
definition: self-contained studio flash head with its own power supply and modelling lamp.
notes: B&H monolights (324): Godox, Profoto, Elinchrom, Broncolor; stand-mount heads with LED modelling lamp.

name: Studio flash pack and head
definition: studio flash whose power pack is separate from one or more flash heads.
notes: B&H power packs and separate heads; Elinchrom ELB 500 pack sold with one or two flash heads.

name: LED panel
definition: flat panel of LEDs giving constant light.
notes: Adorama LED lighting category Light Panels (85), e.g. Litepanels Astra 6X panel.

name: COB LED light
definition: single chip-on-board LED source, usually in a reflector or with a modifier mount.
notes: Godox COB Lights category and amaran Ray COB lights; only category and accessory titles shown.

name: Fresnel light
definition: constant light with a stepped Fresnel lens that focuses the beam.
notes: Adorama Fresnel LED lights: Litepanels Sola, Elation KL Fresnel, ARRI L7-C, Godox F7.

name: Ring light
definition: circular light source made to surround the lens or the subject's face.
notes: Adorama LED category Ring Lights (4); UBeesize 22 in ring light; Godox LR150 Air inflatable ring light.

name: Softbox
definition: fabric box with a diffusion front that softens a light placed behind it (strip box and octabox are non-maker named forms).
notes: Adorama softboxes shapes octagon, rectangle, strip, lantern, beauty dish softbox; Godox octabox, strip box.

name: Umbrella
definition: umbrella-shaped reflector or shoot-through diffuser for a light.
notes: Umbrellas and Accessories (232); Westcott satin, Profoto deep and shallow umbrellas, Godox parabolic umbrella.

name: Reflector dish
definition: metal bowl that directs light from a flash head.
notes: Profoto 13 in TeleZoom Reflector, SpillKill Reflector; B&H reflector types umbrella reflectors, magnums, standard.

name: Portable reflector or diffuser
definition: collapsible disc or panel that bounces or diffuses light.
notes: Westcott Illuminator 48x72 QuickGrip 5-in-1 Reflector; Glow Reflector Panel and Sun Scrim Kit.

name: Beauty dish
definition: shallow dish with a central deflector that gives a crisp, wrapped light.
notes: Godox BDR-S55 Pro and BDR-W550 beauty dishes; Profoto Silver Softlight Reflector (Beauty Dish).

name: Snoot
definition: tube that narrows a light to a small circle.
notes: Godox Witstro Snoot AD-S9 (conical and cylindrical); Elinchrom Snoot 26425.

name: Grid
definition: honeycomb or egg-crate that narrows and straightens a beam.
notes: Profoto honeycomb grid for Softlight Reflector, Softgrid; Godox egg crate grids.

name: Barn doors
definition: hinged flaps fitted to a light to cut and shape the beam.
notes: Godox BD-100 Barndoor, 4-Leaf Barndoors Kit; Barndoors (91) filter.

name: Gobo
definition: pattern or shape cutout placed in a beam to project a shadow or pattern.
notes: Godox VSA-GS4 Gobo Set; Lenses and Gobos category (236); Dedolight gobo holder.

name: Colour gel
definition: coloured or correction sheet fitted over a light.
notes: Lighting Gels and Diffusion (1036); Rosco Color Correction Filter Kit; Godox VSA-11C Color Effect Set.

name: Light stand
definition: adjustable stand that carries a light or modifier (the C-stand is a non-maker named form).
notes: B&H light stands; types C-Stand, General Purpose, Crank and Wind-Up, Roller Base; Impact, Manfrotto, Matthews.

name: Boom arm
definition: counterweighted arm that carries a light overhead.
notes: Impact Combo Boom Stand; RedWing Boom Arm 185cm for light stand with counterweight.

name: Backdrop stand
definition: stand and crossbar that hold a studio backdrop (R-1; the backdrop itself is B2).
notes: Two stands plus crossbar background support systems (Flashpoint, Manfrotto, Westcott, Phottix, Photoflex).

name: Tripod
definition: three-legged stand for a camera.
notes: Adorama carbon-fibre travel tripods (Peak Design, Gitzo, Benro, Manfrotto); Camera Store Tripods (98).

name: Tabletop tripod
definition: very short tripod for a table or surface.
notes: Camera Store category Tabletop Tripods (23); category name only, no product shown.

name: Tripod head
definition: separate head (ball, pan-and-tilt, fluid, gimbal, panoramic) that mounts on a tripod or monopod.
notes: Ball heads, 3-way heads, gimbal heads (Wimberley, Benro, Sirui), geared panoramic head; Tripod Heads (61).

name: Quick-release system
definition: plate, L-bracket or collar that lets a camera or lens click on and off a support.
notes: Manfrotto 200PL plates, iFootage L-shape plate; Quick Release Plates (24) with SmallRig L-plates.

name: Monopod
definition: single-leg support.
notes: Camera Store Monopods (25): Leofoto MPC-366CL carbon fibre monopod.

name: Handheld gimbal stabiliser
definition: motorised handheld stabiliser for a camera.
notes: Adorama Handheld Gimbal Stabilizers (56); Zhiyun WEEBILL 5, DJI RS 4 Mini accessories.

name: Camera rig
definition: shoulder or frame system that carries a camera with accessories.
notes: Supports and Rigs (187): Tilta shoulder rig, SmallRig HawkLock, Zacuto Recoil, CAMVATE shoulder rigs.

name: Camera cage
definition: frame that fits around a camera body and gives it mounting points.
notes: Tilta Full Camera Cage Kit for Sony a7 IV, CAMVATE Camera Cage Rig; Cages and Arms filter (666).

name: Camera mount and clamp
definition: clamp or bracket that fixes a camera to a pole, rail, window or vehicle.
notes: Manfrotto Magic Arms, friction arms and flex arms for Super Clamp; clamp itself named only in titles.

name: Black-and-white negative film
definition: panchromatic negative film processed in black-and-white chemistry.
notes: Analogue Wonderland Black and White Film (57): HP5 Plus, Tri-X 400, T-Max, Kentmere, Fomapan.

name: Colour negative film (C-41)
definition: still-photography colour negative film processed in the C-41 process.
notes: Kodak Portra 160/800, Kodacolor Gold 200, Ektacolor Pro 400 (C-41) listed as colour negative.

name: Colour negative film (ECN-2, motion picture)
definition: cinema colour negative stock processed in the ECN-2 process.
notes: Flic Film Cinecolor 500T developer ECN-2 (respooled Vision3 500T); Kodak Vision3 200T ECN-2 listing.

name: Colour reversal film (E-6)
definition: slide film processed in the E-6 process to a positive.
notes: Analogue Wonderland Colour Slide Film, process E-6: Ektachrome E100, Velvia 50/100, Provia 100F.

name: Integral instant film
definition: self-developing film in a frame that develops in the print itself.
notes: Instant film: Polaroid 600 and i-Type, Instax Mini, Wide, Square, all integral; Adorama lists 59.

name: Peel-apart instant film
definition: instant film pack whose negative and positive are separated after development.
notes: Fujifilm FP-100C described as peel-apart-type instant colour film for type 669 cameras; unavailable.

name: Developing tank
definition: light-tight tank in which film is processed.
notes: Paterson Multi-Reel 8 Developing Tank; Freestyle tanks: Paterson, Jobo, Arista, Cesco.

name: Developing reel
definition: spiral reel that holds film in a tank.
notes: Hewes Pro Stainless Steel Reel, Paterson Auto Load Adjustable Reel, Arista reels, Jobo Duo reel.

name: Changing bag
definition: light-proof bag for loading film into a tank.
notes: Paterson Photographic Changing Bag 27x30 in for loading film into a tank.

name: Enlarger
definition: darkroom projector that exposes a negative onto paper (condenser, diffusion or colour dichroic: `enlarger_type` attribute).
notes: Beseler enlargers at Adorama: Printmaker 35, 67 VC, 23CIII-XL; condenser, dichroic types.

name: Enlarging lens
definition: lens made to project a negative in an enlarger.
notes: Schneider 50mm f/2.8 Componon-S enlarging lens, M39 mount, a darkroom lens not a camera lens.

name: Enlarging easel
definition: frame that holds paper flat under an enlarger.
notes: Freestyle supply list names easel (Arista 4-in-1 Enlarging Easel), quick and bladed easels.

name: Focus finder
definition: magnifier used to focus the projected grain.
notes: Paterson Major Focus Finder; Peak 2030 Enlarging Focuser; LegacyPro 10x Grain Focuser.

name: Darkroom timer
definition: timer that controls the enlarger or safelight.
notes: Freestyle timers: GraLab, Time-O-Lite, Kaiser, Beseler, CatLABS; Beseler 8197 controls enlarger and safelight.

name: Enlarger filter
definition: multigrade or colour filter for the enlarger.
notes: Ilford Multigrade Filter Sets, enlarger type filter B&W condenser, variable contrast, colour dichroic.

name: Developing tray
definition: shallow tray for print chemistry.
notes: Freestyle Trays: Paterson, Arista, Cesco developing trays 5x7 to 30x40.

name: Safelight
definition: darkroom lamp that does not fog paper.
notes: Freestyle safelights (11): Arista, Paterson Red Dome, LegacyPro, ARS-IMAGO.

name: Print dryer
definition: equipment for drying prints.
notes: Paterson Rapid Print Drying Rack; B&H Print Washers and Dryers category (partial, no product).

name: Photographic chemistry
definition: developer, stop, fixer and related chemistry (`chemical_type` attribute).
notes: Ilford Black & White Chemicals (32): film developer, fixer, paper developer, stop bath, wash aid, wetting agent.

name: Photographic printing paper
definition: light-sensitive paper for prints (K-156; `paper_process`: silver-gelatin fibre or resin-coated, chromogenic, inkjet photo paper).
notes: Adorama Enlarging Paper (224): Ilford Multigrade RC and FB, Arista EDU Ultra, Fujicolor Crystal Archive.

name: Camera bag or case
definition: bag, backpack or case made to carry a camera and lenses.
notes: Adorama Camera Bags & Cases: backpacks, shoulder, sling, waist packs, rolling cases, insert bags.

name: Camera strap
definition: strap or sling that carries a camera.
notes: Camera Store Camera Straps (97): shoulder, wrist, rope, sling harness, leather.

name: Camera battery
definition: rechargeable battery made for a camera.
notes: Adorama Camera Batteries (441): Nikon EN-EL15C, Canon LP-E10, Leica BP-SCL7, Panasonic DMW-BLK22.

name: Camera battery charger
definition: charger made for a camera battery.
notes: Adorama camera battery chargers: Canon LC-E6, Nikon MH-25a, Leica BC-SCL7, multi-brand chargers.

name: Battery grip
definition: grip that adds a second battery and controls to a camera body.
notes: Adorama battery grips: Sony VG-C4EM, Canon BG-E20; Battery Grips subcategory under Camera Accessories.

name: Viewfinder or eyepiece
definition: viewfinder, eyepiece or magnifier fitted to a camera.
notes: External viewfinders: Ricoh GV-3, Leica Visoflex 2, Sigma LVF-11, Zacuto Z-Finder, Hoodman Live View kit.

name: Remote shutter release
definition: cable or wireless release for a camera, including camera-specific cables.
notes: Remote Controls: Nikon MC-DC3 release cord, Kaiser shutter release cords, camera-specific cables.

name: Light meter (exposure and flash)
definition: handheld meter that measures light for exposure.
notes: Light Meters: Sekonic L-858D-U, LiteMaster Pro L-478D, L-398A; flash meter and spot filters.

name: Camera cleaning kit
definition: kit for cleaning a lens or sensor.
notes: Sensor cleaning kits: Visible Dust EZ, Pentax O-ICK1, K&F Concept, Photographic Solutions.

name: Underwater housing
definition: waterproof case made for a camera.
notes: Underwater Camera Housings (34): Ikelite 200DL, OM SYSTEM PT-059, Ricoh TW-2, Sony MPK-HSR1.

name: Lens hood
definition: shade that fits the front of a lens.
notes: Camera Store Lens Hoods (192): Canon ET-74B, Nikon HB-32, Fujifilm LH-XF35, OM System LH-76.

name: Lens cap
definition: cover for the front or rear of a lens.
notes: Adorama Lens Caps (331): front, rear and snap-on caps from Nikon, Sony, Fujifilm, Samyang.

name: Telescope camera adapter
definition: T-ring or adapter that fits a camera to a telescope.
notes: Baader T-Ring Camera Adapter, Celestron T-Ring for Sony E, Tele Vue and iOptron T-rings.
